```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Prosperous democracies depend upon the promise of shared economic opportunity across national borders.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If the globalized information economy provokes a fearful drift into national or regional isolation, hopes for a better world will vanish.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Institutions founded in the Second World War and its aftermath built the basis for America's position today.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Bretton Woods monetary system and the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade were partly sustained by the Cold War.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States should devise new mechanisms to enable the private sector to unleash productivity, innovation, and a free flow of ideas.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Communities of private groups can achieve results far beyond the reach of governments and international bureaucracies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"With close cooperation between a Republican president and a Republican Congress, the United States can gain from the widening global influence of American citizens, businesses, associations, and norms.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A Republican administration will have the opportunity to fashion, with like-minded nations, the international structures of sustainable prosperity for the next several decades.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States can gain from the widening global influence of American citizens, businesses, associations, and norms given close cooperation between a Republican president and a Republican Congress.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
